sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: It's summertime, so we felt we had to start our show with a scene from the iconic summer vacation movie.
sentences.zh: 现在是夏天，所以我们觉得节目开场必须播放一部标志性暑期度假电影的片段。

sentences.en: Where in the 1980s, the Griswolds are packed into their station wagon.
sentences.zh: 那是20世纪80年代，格里斯沃尔德一家挤在他们的旅行车里。

sentences.en: It's pouring rain.
sentences.zh: 外面大雨倾盆。

sentences.en: Everything has gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 所有事情都不顺利。

sentences.en: They're on this disastrous road trip to a moose-centric theme park.
sentences.zh: 他们正在进行一场去往驼鹿主题公园的灾难般的公路旅行。

sentences.en: The wife and kids suggest that it's perhaps time to just go home.
sentences.zh: 妻子和孩子们暗示，也许是时候直接回家了。

sentences.en: I don't want to be in the car anymore.
sentences.zh: 我不想再待在车里了。

sentences.en: I want to go home.
sentences.zh: 我想回家。

sentences.en: Oh, Clark, under the circumstances, I wouldn't mind if we just went home.
sentences.zh: 噢，克拉克，在这种情况下，如果我们直接回家，我倒也不介意。

sentences.en: But the dad, Chevy Chase, has other ideas.
sentences.zh: 但身为父亲的切维·切斯另有打算。

sentences.en: We're ten hours from the fun park and you want to bail out.
sentences.zh: 离游乐园只有十小时路程了，你们却想当逃兵。

sentences.en: Well, I'll tell you something.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我告诉你们。

sentences.en: This is no longer a vacation.
sentences.zh: 这不再是一场度假。

sentences.en: It's a queSt. It's a quest for fun.
sentences.zh: 这是一次远征。这是一场寻找快乐的远征。

sentences.en: I'm going to have fun and you're going to have fun.
sentences.zh: 我要玩得开心，你们也得玩得开心。

sentences.en: We're all going to have so much f***ing fun, we'll need plastic surgery to remove our goddamn smiles.
sentences.zh: 我们大家都要玩得他妈的这么开心，到时候得整容才能去掉我们该死的笑容。

sentences.en: I've got to be crazy.
sentences.zh: 我一定疯了。

sentences.en: I'm on a pilgrimage to see a moose.
sentences.zh: 我正在进行一场朝圣，只为了去看一只驼鹿。

sentences.en: Praise Marty Moose!
sentences.zh: 赞美马蒂驼鹿！

sentences.en: Summer vacations.
sentences.zh: 暑期度假。

sentences.en: We wait for them all year.
sentences.zh: 我们盼了一整年。

sentences.en: We pour time, energy, and money into planning them.
sentences.zh: 我们倾注了时间、精力和金钱来规划它们。

sentences.en: Expectations run unreasonably high.
sentences.zh: 期望值高得离谱。

sentences.en: Coming up, a summer edition of Stopwatch Science.
sentences.zh: 接下来是“秒表科学”夏季特辑。

sentences.en: How to plan a vacation, what vacations can reveal about your stock portfolio,
sentences.zh: 如何规划假期，假期能透露出你的股票投资组合的什么信息，

sentences.en: and why vacations can be bad for your waistline.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么假期对你的腰围有害。

sentences.en: If you're like me, Shankar, vacations bring to mind two words.
sentences.zh: 如果你和我一样，尚卡尔，假期会让人联想到两个词。

sentences.en: Creeping obesity.
sentences.zh: 悄然滋长的肥胖。

sentences.en: Stay with us.
sentences.zh: 请继续收听。

sentences.en: Support for this podcast and the following message come from Stitch Fix,
sentences.zh: 本播客及以下内容的赞助支持来自Stitch Fix，

sentences.en: an online personal styling service that makes shopping effortless and fun for busy women on the go.
sentences.zh: 这是一家在线个人造型服务公司，为忙碌的职场女性让购物变得轻松又有趣。

sentences.en: Complete your personal style quiz and then schedule a date to receive your first personalized shipment.
sentences.zh: 完成你的个人风格测试，然后预约时间接收你的第一批个性化定制服装。

sentences.en: There's no subscription required.
sentences.zh: 无需订购。

sentences.en: Your stylist will send you five hand-selected pieces of clothing delivered right to your door.
sentences.zh: 你的造型师会为你精心挑选五件衣物直接送到你家门口。

sentences.en: Buy what you want and send the rest back.
sentences.zh: 买你想要的，把剩下的退回。

sentences.en: Shipping is easy and free both ways.
sentences.zh: 双向运费既简便又免费。

sentences.en: To get started, visit stitchfix.com.
sentences.zh: 要开始体验，请访问stitchfix.com。

sentences.en: That's S-T-I-T-C-H-F-I-X dot com.
sentences.zh: 网址是S-T-I-T-C-H-F-I-X点com。

sentences.en: Support also comes from Outdoor Voices,
sentences.zh: 支持还来自Outdoor Voices，

sentences.en: a new sportswear brand that takes a totally different approach to getting active.
sentences.zh: 一个采用完全不同方式来倡导积极生活的新运动服饰品牌。

sentences.en: Instead of harder, faster, stronger,
sentences.zh: 比起更拼、更快、更强，

sentences.en: they're all about embracing activity with ease, humor, and delight.
sentences.zh: 他们更致力于以轻松、幽默和愉悦的态度拥抱活力。

sentences.en: Outdoor Voices delivers men's and women's technical athletic wear
sentences.zh: Outdoor Voices提供男女技术运动服装，

sentences.en: that's streamlined, comfortable, and made to laSt.
sentences.zh: 剪裁流畅、舒适且经久耐穿。

sentences.en: And they're offering 15% off to our listeners.
sentences.zh: 他们为我们的听众提供85折优惠。

sentences.en: Just go to outdoorvoices.com slash brain and enter coupon code BRAIN.
sentences.zh: 只需访问outdoorvoices.com斜杠brain并输入优惠码BRAIN。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆。

sentences.en: I'm joined now by Daniel Pink.
sentences.zh: 和我一起连线的是丹尼尔·平克。

sentences.en: He's the author of several books about human behavior.
sentences.zh: 他是多本关于人类行为书籍的作者。

sentences.en: But on our show, as you know, his title is Senior Stopwatch Science Correspondent.
sentences.zh: 但在我们的节目中，正如你所知，他的头衔是“秒表科学”资深记者。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dan.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，丹。

sentences.en: Thank you, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，尚卡尔。

sentences.en: It's great to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So on Stopwatch Science, Dan and I give one another 60 seconds to summarize interesting social science research.
sentences.zh: 那么在“秒表科学”环节，我和丹会给彼此60秒时间来总结有趣的社会科学研究。

sentences.en: As we approach the one-minute mark, our producers will bring up the music,
sentences.zh: 当我们接近一分钟大关时，我们的制作人会响起音乐，

sentences.en: sometimes gently, sometimes loudly, to let us know our time is running out.
sentences.zh: 有时轻柔，有时响亮，来让我们知道时间快到了。

sentences.en: Our topic today is vacations.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的主题是假期。

sentences.en: This week, we'll tell you why it's so important to take one and how to get the most out of your vacation.
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将告诉你为什么休假如此重要，以及如何让你的假期收获最大化。

sentences.en: You know, Dan, whenever I'm with you, I actually feel like I'm on vacation.
sentences.zh: 你知道，丹，每当我和你在一起时，我真的觉得自己像在度假。

sentences.en: Is that why you're in a swimsuit?
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你穿着泳衣吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: All righty.
sentences.zh: 好勒。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: Let's do some science.
sentences.zh: 我们来做点科学研究。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Dan, your first 60 seconds starts now.
sentences.zh: 丹，你的前60秒现在开始。

sentences.en: Shankar, everyone here at NPR headquarters knows that you're an upstanding citizen who never,
sentences.zh: 尚卡尔，NPR总部的每个人都知道你是一个正派的公民，绝不会

sentences.en: ever would use his work computer for personal tasks.
sentences.zh: 在工作电脑上处理个人事务。

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 他们确实知道。

sentences.en: But some people aren't as scrupulous as you.
sentences.zh: 但有些人不像你那么谨慎。

sentences.en: And when it comes to vacation planning, that might be costing them.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到假期规划时，这可能会让他们付出代价。

sentences.en: Wei Zhang of Iowa State University and Ajay Kalra of Rice University
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州立大学的韦张和莱斯大学的阿杰·卡尔拉

sentences.en: looked at a large trove of data from an online hotel reservation site.
sentences.zh: 研究了来自一个在线酒店预订网站的大量数据。

sentences.en: They found that people who booked leisure travel during work hours
sentences.zh: 他们发现，在工作时间预订休闲旅行的人

sentences.en: selected higher quality hotels than those who booked during non-work hours.
sentences.zh: 比在非工作时间预订的人选了更高品质的酒店。

sentences.en: But once the vacation was over, those making reservations from the office
sentences.zh: 但一旦假期结束，那些在办公室预订的人

sentences.en: ended up less satisfied with their hotel choice.
sentences.zh: 最终对自己的酒店选择不那么满意。

sentences.en: Now, it's not clear exactly what's going on here, but one explanation seems plausible.
sentences.zh: 现在，这里具体发生了什么尚不清楚，但有一个解释似乎很合理。

sentences.en: When we're at work, we're more likely to be stressed out and depleted
sentences.zh: 当我们在工作时，我们更有可能感到压力山大和精力耗尽，

sentences.en: and therefore less likely to be vigilant.
sentences.zh: 因此不那么保持警惕。

sentences.en: So instead of pushing hard to find a great deal,
sentences.zh: 所以，与其极力寻找一个极好的优惠，

sentences.en: we settle for an okay deal that we later regret.
sentences.zh: 我们不如凑合接受一个还算可以的优惠，随后便会后悔。

sentences.en: Whatever the reason, though, the message is clear.
sentences.zh: 不过无论原因是什么，信息很明确。

sentences.en: Don't shop for travel at work.
sentences.zh: 不要在工作时购买旅游产品。

sentences.en: So let me understand this correctly.
sentences.zh: 所以让我正确理解这一点。

sentences.en: They're saying that because people are stressed out and busy
sentences.zh: 他们是说，因为人们压力大又忙碌，

sentences.en: or maybe especially in need of a vacation when they're at work,
sentences.zh: 或者可能在工作时特别需要度假，

sentences.en: they go online, they see something really snazzy, interesting, beautiful,
sentences.zh: 他们上网，看到了一些非常时髦、有趣、美好的东西，

sentences.en: and they say, yeah, I'm going to buy that.
sentences.zh: 然后他们说，好吧，我要买这个。

sentences.en: But then when they actually go there,
sentences.zh: 但当他们真正去到那里时，

sentences.en: they find that if they had shopped around for another 10 minutes,
sentences.zh: 他们发现，如果他们再多花10分钟货比三家，

sentences.en: they could have found something that was actually a better deal.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以找到一个其实更划算的交易。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But we have only one deal here on Stopwatch Science,
sentences.zh: 但我们在“秒表科学”只有一个交易，

sentences.en: and that's a deal that involves 60 seconds.
sentences.zh: 那就是包含60秒的交易。

sentences.en: And those 60 seconds begin right now.
sentences.zh: 而那60秒现在开始。

sentences.en: All right, when we think about great vacations,
sentences.zh: 好吧，当我们想到美好的假期时，

sentences.en: we often think about going to unusual places,
sentences.zh: 我们经常会想到去不寻常的地方，

sentences.en: maybe going to a place that few other people have got.
sentences.zh: 也许去一个极少其他人去过的地方。

sentences.en: Maybe you're already doing this.
sentences.zh: 也许你已经在这么做了。

sentences.en: You're listening to this podcast right now on a beach in Tahiti.
sentences.zh: 你现在正躺在大溪地的海滩上听这个播客。

sentences.en: One advantage of unusual vacations is that we can then post pictures on Facebook
sentences.zh: 不寻常假期的好处之一是，我们可以把照片发到Facebook上，

sentences.en: or come home and tell our friends all about our amazing vacation.
sentences.zh: 或者回家把我们神奇的假期讲给朋友们听。

sentences.en: Now, since they haven't been to these wonderful locales,
sentences.zh: 既然他们没有去过这些美妙的地方，

sentences.en: they will be eager listeners for our stories, right?
sentences.zh: 他们会渴望听我们讲故事，对吧？

sentences.en: So we think.
sentences.zh: 我们是这么想的。

sentences.en: No, they won't.
sentences.zh: 不，他们才不。

sentences.en: Gus Cooney and Dan Gilbert at Harvard,
sentences.zh: 哈佛大学的格斯·库尼和丹·吉尔伯特，

sentences.en: along with Timothy Wilson at the University of Virginia,
sentences.zh: 以及弗吉尼亚大学的蒂莫西·威尔逊发现，

sentences.en: find that when people have amazingly unique experiences,
sentences.zh: 当人们拥有惊人独特的经历时，

sentences.en: they're often less happy afterward.
sentences.zh: 他们事后往往不那么快乐。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Your friends don't want to hear you drone on about getting on that SpaceX flight.
sentences.zh: 你的朋友们才不想听你喋喋不休地讲你坐了那次SpaceX的飞行。

sentences.en: They're talking to each other about the block party in the neighborhood that you missed,
sentences.zh: 他们在互相谈论你错过的那个社区街区派对，

sentences.en: so you feel socially isolated.
sentences.zh: 所以你会感到被社交孤立。

sentences.en: Social isolation matters more to your happiness than your vacation destination.
sentences.zh: 社交孤立对你快乐的影响，比你的度假目的地更重要。

sentences.en: This is very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: So how did they do this?
sentences.zh: 那他们是怎么做这个实验的？

sentences.en: Did they send one group of people to the Caribbean
sentences.zh: 他们把一组人送到加勒比海，

sentences.en: and another group to the banks of the Olentangy River in central Ohio?
sentences.zh: 把另一组人送到俄亥俄州中部的奥伦坦吉河畔吗？

sentences.en: They both sound pretty exotic to me, Dan.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这两个听起来都挺有异国情调的，丹。

sentences.en: But no, that's not what they did.
sentences.zh: 但不是，他们不是这么做的。

sentences.en: This was a social psychology experiment, which means it was done on the cheap.
sentences.zh: 这是一场社会心理学实验，这意味着它是低成本完成的。

sentences.en: What they did is they brought in volunteers into a laboratory,
sentences.zh: 他们做的是把志愿者请进实验室，

sentences.en: and they sat the majority of them down together to watch a very mediocre movie.
sentences.zh: 让他们中的大多数人坐在一起看一部非常平庸的电影。

sentences.en: And they sat one person down to watch an absolutely fantastic, riveting movie.
sentences.zh: 然后他们让一个人坐下来看一部绝对精彩、扣人心弦的电影。

sentences.en: And then they put the whole group together to talk.
sentences.zh: 接着他们把整组人聚在一起聊天。

sentences.en: And the person who watched the amazing movie wanted to talk about the amazing movie that he or she had watched.
sentences.zh: 那个看了精彩电影的人想聊聊他或她看过的精彩电影。

sentences.en: But, of course, none of the others had seen the amazing movie,
sentences.zh: 但是，当然，其他人都没有看过这部精彩的电影，

sentences.en: and they didn't really want to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 他们其实并不想聊这个。

sentences.en: They wanted to talk about what a silly experiment this was.
sentences.zh: 他们想聊的是这回实验有多么愚蠢。

sentences.en: The others bonded with each other, and the person who watched the great movie ended up feeling isolated.
sentences.zh: 其他人彼此打成一片，而看了好电影的那个人最终感到了孤立。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: And so how does this play into this idea that experiences are more valuable to us than goods?
sentences.zh: 那么这如何与“体验比物品对我们更有价值”这个观点相呼应呢？

sentences.en: That's interesting because there is a lot of research showing that experiences are more valuable than things when you're buying yourself gifts.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为有很多研究表明，当你给自己买礼物时，体验比物品更有价值。

sentences.en: But I've actually come by recent work, Dan, that actually finds that the reason experiences are often better than things as gifts
sentences.zh: 但丹，我最近接触到的一项研究发现，体验之所以作为礼物通常比物品更好，

sentences.en: is that experiences are inherently often social.
sentences.zh: 其实是因为体验本质上往往具有社交性。

sentences.en: If you're going on an experience and actually enjoying it entirely by yourself,
sentences.zh: 如果你去经历某种体验，实际上完全是由你自己一个人享受，

sentences.en: it's not clear that it actually is much better than just buying yourself a new television set or a new car.
sentences.zh: 那它是否真的比单纯给自己买台新电视机或新车好得多，还真说不准。

sentences.en: It's the social aspect of experiences that makes them better.
sentences.zh: 正是体验的社交属性让它们变得更好。

sentences.en: This is why when I do stopwatch science by myself at home, it's no fun.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我在家里一个人做秒表科学时，一点意思也没有。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Speaking of unique and extraordinary experiences, Dan,
sentences.zh: 说到独特而非凡的体验，丹，

sentences.en: I hope your next 60 seconds doesn't leave me feeling socially isolated.
sentences.zh: 我希望你的下一个60秒不会让我感到被社交孤立。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: If you're like me, Shankar, vacations bring to mind two words.
sentences.zh: 尚卡尔，如果你也像我一样，度假会让你联想到两个词。

sentences.en: Creeping obesity.
sentences.zh: 逐渐发胖。

sentences.en: That's the medical concept for what happens to many of us in middle age.
sentences.zh: 这是医学概念，用来形容我们很多人在中年时发生的变化。

sentences.en: We don't become overweight overnight.
sentences.zh: 我们不会一夜之间体重超标。

sentences.en: Instead, we gain a pound or two each year,
sentences.zh: 相反，我们每年会增重一两磅，

sentences.en: and before long, that person in the mirror looks a little different.
sentences.zh: 不知不觉中，镜子里的那个人看起来就有点不一样了。

sentences.en: Well, according to a recent paper in the journal Physiology and Behavior,
sentences.zh: 嗯，根据《生理学与行为》杂志上最近的一篇论文，

sentences.en: our vacations could be part of the problem.
sentences.zh: 我们的假期可能是问题的一部分。

sentences.en: These researchers studied 122 adults who'd gone on vacations of between one and three weeks.
sentences.zh: 这些研究人员研究了122名度假一到三周的成年人。

sentences.en: They find that these folks each gained nearly a pound on vacation
sentences.zh: 他们发现这些人度假时每人体重增加了近一磅，

sentences.en: and that the extra weight was still there six weeks later.
sentences.zh: 而且六周后这多出来的体重依然没有消失。

sentences.en: Now, the reason is intriguing.
sentences.zh: 原因其实挺有意思的。

sentences.en: Turns out people are more physically active on vacation, so inactivity wasn't the cause.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，人们在度假时身体活动更多，所以缺乏运动并不是原因。

sentences.en: The real culprit was that vacationers increased their calorie consumption in excess of their activity,
sentences.zh: 真正的罪魁祸首是度假者的卡路里摄入量超过了他们的活动量，

sentences.en: especially in the form of alcohol.
sentences.zh: 尤其是以酒精的形式。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，当然。

sentences.en: So, if you want to avoid weight gain while on holiday, try to drink less,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想在假期避免体重增加，尽量少喝点酒，

sentences.en: although that might be tough if you're on a family vacation.
sentences.zh: 尽管如果你是和家人一起度假，这可能有点难。

sentences.en: So, this makes total sense to me, Dan.
sentences.zh: 丹，这对我来说完全说得通。

sentences.en: I often feel that I'm significantly more active when I'm on vacations,
sentences.zh: 我经常觉得度假时我的活动量明显更多，

sentences.en: but I have noticed that I don't lose weight while I'm on vacations,
sentences.zh: 但我注意到度假期间我并没有减肥，

sentences.en: and it's probably because I'm just eating and drinking more.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是因为我吃得更多、喝得更多。

sentences.en: Right, and especially the drinking part.
sentences.zh: 没错，尤其是喝酒这部分。

sentences.en: This paper showed something like a doubling in alcohol consumption
sentences.zh: 这篇论文显示，在人们外出度假的几周里，

sentences.en: during the weeks that people are away.
sentences.zh: 酒精消耗量大约翻了一番。

sentences.en: So, they're living it up, but they're paying for it later in creeping obesity.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们当时过得很潇洒，但随后就要为逐渐发胖付出代价。

sentences.en: So, speaking of creeping, your moment has crept to us right now,
sentences.zh: 说到逐渐发生，现在轮到你出场了，

sentences.en: and your 60 seconds begins right now.
sentences.zh: 你的60秒现在开始。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Vacations can be fun, they can be relaxing, but they can also be very useful signals.
sentences.zh: 度假可以很有趣，可以让人放松，但它们也可以是非常有用的信号。

sentences.en: Think about your own behavior.
sentences.zh: 想想你自己的行为。

sentences.en: If you're the boss of a company and you're on vacation,
sentences.zh: 如果你是一家公司的老板，正在度假，

sentences.en: is your company likely to make big moves that rock the boat?
sentences.zh: 你的公司会做出打破常规的大动作吗？

sentences.en: Not likely.
sentences.zh: 不太可能。

sentences.en: Or let's say you're the boss and things are falling apart at work.
sentences.zh: 或者假设你是老板，工作正一团糟。

sentences.en: Now, you might have to cancel your vacation to deal with a crisis.
sentences.zh: 现在，你可能不得不取消假期来处理危机。

sentences.en: In other words, paying attention to when the boss goes on vacation can be a market signal.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，关注老板什么时候去度假可以成为一个市场信号。

sentences.en: David Yermak at NYU tracked when CEOs go on vacation by merging records of corporate jet flights
sentences.zh: 纽约大学的大卫·耶马克通过整合公司公务机航班记录

sentences.en: and where CEOs of various companies are known to have vacation properties.
sentences.zh: 以及已知各公司CEO拥有度假物业的地点，追踪了CEO们何时去度假。

sentences.en: He finds that CEOs are more likely to go on vacation right after their companies announce good news,
sentences.zh: 他发现，CEO们更有可能在公司宣布好消息后立刻去度假，

sentences.en: and he also finds that stock prices for a company are less volatile when the CEO is on break.
sentences.zh: 他还发现，当CEO休假时，公司股价波动较小。

sentences.en: In other words, if you and I were running a hedge fund, Dan,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，丹，如果我们俩在经营一家对冲基金，

sentences.en: we might want to keep better track of which CEOs are hitting the beach this summer
sentences.zh: 我们可能需要更好地追踪今年夏天哪些CEO去了海滩度假，

sentences.en: and which ones are canceling their travel plans.
sentences.zh: 哪些人取消了行程。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is a great study.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一项很棒的研究。

sentences.en: This is really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: So do you think that investors' funds are actually using this kind of information to make bets on companies?
sentences.zh: 那你认为投资者的资金实际上是在利用这类信息来对公司进行押注吗？

sentences.en: I think they might be, except it probably isn't easy to come by all the information that David Yermak pulled together.
sentences.zh: 我想他们可能在这么做，只是大卫·耶马克收集的所有信息可能没那么容易获取。

sentences.en: It's also probably the case that the signal is a small signal.
sentences.zh: 这种情况也可能表明，这个信号其实很微弱。

sentences.en: So the only way to really be successful at this is if you apply this strategy over a very, very lengthy period of time.
sentences.zh: 所以要在这个策略上真正取得成功，唯一的办法就是在非常非常长的一段时间内应用它。

sentences.en: And in the long run, the law of averages will work in your favor.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，大数定律会站在你这边。

sentences.en: Now, the law of averages don't necessarily work on your favor in stopwatch science
sentences.zh: 不过，大数定律在秒表科学中不一定对你有利，

sentences.en: because we have only 60 seconds to pull things off.
sentences.zh: 因为我们只有60秒的时间来完成任务。

sentences.en: And your next 60 seconds, Dan, starts right now.
sentences.zh: 丹，你的下一个60秒现在开始。

sentences.en: Now, vacations can recharge the mind and replenish the soul.
sentences.zh: 度假可以重塑心灵，滋养灵魂。

sentences.en: But once we're back on the job, how long do the positive effects last?
sentences.zh: 但一旦我们回到工作岗位，积极的影响能持续多久？

sentences.en: Two German psychologists tackled that question in the Journal of Organizational Behavior.
sentences.zh: 两位德国心理学家在《组织行为学杂志》上探讨了这个问题。

sentences.en: The researchers chose a profession with lots of stress and high burnout rates, teachers.
sentences.zh: 研究人员选择了一个压力大、职业倦怠率高的职业——教师。

sentences.en: They had teachers fill out questionnaires the day before a two-week vacation
sentences.zh: 他们让教师在两周假期开始的前一天填写问卷，

sentences.en: and then three more times after the vacation had ended and they were back on the job.
sentences.zh: 然后在假期结束、他们重返工作岗位后又填写了三次。

sentences.en: First, the good news.
sentences.zh: 首先是好消息。

sentences.en: When the teachers returned to the classroom after their break,
sentences.zh: 当老师们休假归来重返课堂时，

sentences.en: they were more engaged in their jobs and significantly less emotionally exhausted.
sentences.zh: 他们对工作的投入度更高，情感耗竭也明显减少。

sentences.en: The vacation worked.
sentences.zh: 度假起作用了。

sentences.en: Now, the less good news.
sentences.zh: 现在是不太好的消息。

sentences.en: That positive boost faded away after only about four weeks.
sentences.zh: 这种积极的提升在仅仅大约四周后就消失了。

sentences.en: A month after returning to work,
sentences.zh: 重返工作岗位一个月后，

sentences.en: they were generally back to their pre-vocation levels of engagement and exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作投入度和疲惫程度基本回到了度假前的水平。

sentences.en: Now, we can't leap to universal conclusions here.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们不能在这里得出普遍性的结论。

sentences.en: Maybe there's something unique about teachers or Germans.
sentences.zh: 也许老师或德国人有什么独特之处。

sentences.en: But if the benefits of time off do fade out so quickly, perhaps we should all be taking more vacations.
sentences.zh: 但如果假期的好处消退得这么快，也许我们都应该多度几次假。

sentences.en: There's something terribly sad about that story, Dan, because it really suggests that we have these dreams about what vacations will do.
sentences.zh: 丹，这个故事听起来非常悲伤，因为它确实表明我们对度假的作用抱有各种幻想。

sentences.en: And even when those dreams come true, what you're saying is that the effects are likely to be very short-lived.
sentences.zh: 即使这些幻想成真了，你的意思是这种效果很可能非常短暂。

sentences.en: That's what it seems like.
sentences.zh: 看起来确实如此。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: We've seen that before in other areas.
sentences.zh: 我们在其他领域也见过这种情况。

sentences.en: If you look at weight, generally people return to what's called their set point of weight.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看体重，人们通常会恢复到所谓的体重设定点。

sentences.en: They might lose some here, gain some here, but in general, they return to that set point.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会在这里瘦一点，在那里胖一点，但总的来说，他们会回到那个设定点。

sentences.en: Even if you look at this measure of subjective well-being, how happy we are, you know what?
sentences.zh: 即使你看看主观幸福感这个指标，也就是我们有多快乐，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Something really bad happens to you.
sentences.zh: 当你遭遇了非常糟糕的事情时，

sentences.en: It drops.
sentences.zh: 它会下降。

sentences.en: Something really great happens to you.
sentences.zh: 当你遇到了非常棒的事情时，

sentences.en: It goes up, but then it returns to that same level.
sentences.zh: 它会上升，但随后又会回到相同的水平。

sentences.en: Which sort of leads to the question of actually what's the point of taking a vacation at all?
sentences.zh: 这有点引出一个问题，那就是度假到底有什么意义？

sentences.en: If you're going to come back to who you are at the end of it, maybe you should just stay home.
sentences.zh: 如果你度假结束後还是要回到原来的自己，那你或许应该直接待在家里。

sentences.en: Maybe you should just stay at work and just keep working and working and working until you grind yourself into full despair and don't even hit your set point.
sentences.zh: 也许你真该一直待在工作岗位上，不停地工作、工作、工作，直到把自己折腾到彻底绝望，甚至连体重设定点都保不住。

sentences.en: That's a great suggestion.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个绝妙的建议。

sentences.en: I'm sure our listeners would love it.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定我们的听众一定会喜欢。

sentences.en: But I'm hoping that your next one is a little bit more uplifting.
sentences.zh: 但我希望你的下一个话题能稍微振奋人心一点。

sentences.en: Shankar, your 60 seconds start right now.
sentences.zh: 尚卡尔，你的60秒现在开始。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We did a podcast episode recently about Alaska, looking at climate change.
sentences.zh: 我们最近做了一期关于阿拉斯加的播客节目，探讨了气候变化。

sentences.en: I went there on vacation with my family recently.
sentences.zh: 我最近和家人去那里度假了。

sentences.en: And when you're in Alaska, Dan, with all those mountains and glaciers and vast open spaces,
sentences.zh: 丹，当你在阿拉斯加面对那些高山、冰川和广袤的开阔地时，

sentences.en: you can't help but notice that you're a very, very small animal on a very, very big planet.
sentences.zh: 你会情不自禁地意识到，自己在广袤无垠的星球上只是一个极其渺小的生物。

sentences.en: Now, we've all felt this.
sentences.zh: 我们都有过这种感受。

sentences.en: You've looked up at the sky on a dark night.
sentences.zh: 你在黑夜里抬头望向天空。

sentences.en: You've seen the Milky Way where you listen to a beautiful piece of music.
sentences.zh: 你看到了银河，或者聆听了一段美妙的音乐。

sentences.en: You feel a sense of majesty, a sense of awe.
sentences.zh: 你会感受到一种壮丽，一种敬畏之情。

sentences.en: Paul Piff, Dr. Keltner, and many other researchers have found that awe not only does wonderful things for you,
sentences.zh: 保罗·皮夫、凯尔特纳博士和许多其他研究人员发现，敬畏不仅对你大有裨益，

sentences.en: but that it helps you do wonderful things for others.
sentences.zh: 还能促使你为他人做出美好的事。

sentences.en: Volunteers induced to feel awe act more altruistically, more ethically.
sentences.zh: 被激发产生敬畏感的志愿者表现得更加利他、更加合乎道德。

sentences.en: They stop thinking of themselves and their problems as bigger or more important than others.
sentences.zh: 他们不再认为自己和自己的问题比别人更宏大、更重要。

sentences.en: So if you're on vacation right now, whether that's a hike around the neighborhood or a hike around the Grand Canyon,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你现在正在度假，无论是在社区附近远足还是在大峡谷远足，

sentences.en: remember that one of the most important things you can do is to let yourself get caught up in the moment.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你能做的最重要的事情之一，就是让自己沉浸在当下。

sentences.en: Feel grateful.
sentences.zh: 心存感激。

sentences.en: Feel awe.
sentences.zh: 感受敬畏。

sentences.en: It's one of the ways vacations can make us better people.
sentences.zh: 这是假期让我们变得更好的人的方式之一。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So if you're at that block party rather than the SpaceX flight, look up in the air,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是在参加街区派对而不是搭乘太空探索公司的飞船，抬头看看天空，

sentences.en: wave to the other guy who's miserable in that SpaceX flight,
sentences.zh: 向那个在太空飞船里痛苦不堪的家伙挥挥手，

sentences.en: and look at the clouds and just sort of get a sense of awe with your friends and your family.
sentences.zh: 看着云彩，和你的朋友家人一起感受一种敬畏之情。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也这么认为。

sentences.en: This is the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键就在这里。

sentences.en: I think many of us believe that the source of awe is in the things that we're seeing and the things that we're noticing.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们许多人相信，敬畏之源在于我们看到的事物和我们注意到的事物。

sentences.en: But in many ways, I think the source of the awe is in ourselves.
sentences.zh: 但在许多方面，我认为敬畏之源其实在我们自己身上。

sentences.en: It's in our ability, our orientation to actually look at the world and appreciate how marvelous it is.
sentences.zh: 它源于我们的能力，源于我们审视世界、欣赏世界有多么奇妙的心态。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Also, based on that study, I really think that there's a lesson for the Alaska Department of Tourism.
sentences.zh: 另外，根据那项研究，我真的认为这给阿拉斯加旅游局上了一课。

sentences.en: They should have a campaign that says,
sentences.zh: 他们应该开展一项宣传活动，说：

sentences.en: Welcome to Alaska.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: That's yours, folks in Juneau, for the taking.
sentences.zh: 朱诺的居民们，这个口号就归你们了，拿去用吧。

sentences.en: So there's some marketing advice from Dan Pink.
sentences.zh: 以上就是丹·平克的营销建议。

sentences.en: And there you have it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Book your next vacation at home.
sentences.zh: 把下一次假期定在家里吧。

sentences.en: Pick the neighborhood block party over the SpaceX flight.
sentences.zh: 选择社区街区派对，而不是太空探索公司的飞行。

sentences.en: Drink less while you're on vacation.
sentences.zh: 度假时少喝点酒。

sentences.en: Try to keep that vacation bliss going a little longer after you get back,
sentences.zh: 尽量让度假的快乐在回家后多持续一会儿，

sentences.en: perhaps by soaking up lots of awe-inspiring moments.
sentences.zh: 也许可以通过沉浸在许多令人敬畏的时刻中来实现。

sentences.en: Finally, if any of you see Dan Pink hastily cancel his vacation plans at the last minute,
sentences.zh: 最后，如果你们任何人看到丹·平克在最后一分钟仓促取消度假计划，

sentences.en: you can be fairly confident that the Hidden Brain hedge fund that we run together is about to tank.
sentences.zh: 你可以相当确信，我们共同经营的“隐秘大脑”对冲基金马上就要亏损了。

sentences.en: Dan, thank you for joining me.
sentences.zh: 丹，谢谢你加入我。

sentences.en: It's always a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这总是一段愉快的时光。

sentences.en: This episode of Hidden Brain was produced by Max Nestrack and Chris Benderev and edited by Jenny Schmidt.
sentences.zh: 本期《隐秘大脑》由马克斯·内斯特拉克和克里斯·本德雷夫制作，珍妮·施密特剪辑。

sentences.en: Our staff also includes Maggie Penman and Kara McGurk-Allison.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作人员还包括玛吉·彭曼和卡拉·麦格克-艾利森。

sentences.en: We should also say it's Max's last week with us at Hidden Brain before he moves on to a new job in public radio.
sentences.zh: 我们还想说，这是马克斯在《隐秘大脑》陪伴我们的最后一周，之后他将去公共广播电台担任新工作。

sentences.en: Many of you loved our recent episode featuring Max's effort to quit smoking.
sentences.zh: 你们很多人都很喜欢我们最近那期关于马克斯戒烟努力的节目。

sentences.en: He's promised to keep us posted on how that goes.
sentences.zh: 他答应随时向我们通报进展情况。

sentences.en: We're going to miss you, Max.
sentences.zh: 我们会想念你的，马克斯。

sentences.en: You can follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram and listen to my stories on your local public radio station.
sentences.zh: 你可以在脸书、推特和照片墙上关注我们，并收听你在当地公共广播电台播出的我的故事。

sentences.en: If you like this episode, give us a review.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢这期节目，请给我们写个好评。

sentences.en: It helps.
sentences.zh: 这会对我们很有帮助。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantham and this is NPR.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·韦丹塔姆，这里是美国国家公共电台。

sentences.en: Hey, y'all.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Sam Sanders here, campaign reporter with NPR News.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·桑德斯，国家公共电台新闻的竞选记者。

sentences.en: Here to tell you that the NPR Politics Podcast has you covered for the biggest two weeks of this election year so far.
sentences.zh: 在这里告诉大家，《国家公共电台政治播客》将为您全面报道今年大选至今最关键的两周。

sentences.en: Skip the cable news hangover and listen to our daily episodes from the Republican and Democratic conventions in Cleveland and Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 摆脱有线新闻的宿醉，收听我们在克利夫兰和费城的共和党与民主党全国代表大会的每日报道。

sentences.en: Every day about conventions.
sentences.zh: 每天都有关于大会的节目。

sentences.en: It all starts July 19th.
sentences.zh: 一切从7月19日开始。

sentences.en: Subscribe to the NPR Politics Podcast at npr.org slash podcast or on the NPR One app.
sentences.zh: 请登录 npr.org slash podcast 或使用 NPR One 应用程序订阅 NPR 政治播客。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。
